baseline_models.focus_anchor: The movement from divine redirection to the cohort's presence around the recitation.
baseline_models.mechanism: A concealed small cohort is not merely encountered. It is transferred from another direction or state into present attendance, while the recitation acts as a gathering center.

activation_trace.role: Transfer between directions or states grounds deliberate routing into the encounter.
The small mobilizable company supplies a bounded cohort rather than an undifferentiated crowd.
Concealment makes the audience socially unseen even while it is being assembled.
Presence and proximity mark arrival at the recitation as a real threshold.
Collection lets the recitation serve as the center around which the routed cohort coheres.

changed_reading.before: A group of jinn happens to come within hearing range.
changed_reading.after: A hidden plurality is deliberately routed into a temporary listening assembly.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: They actively listen, then one utterance imposes silence on the group.
baseline_models.mechanism: Reception proceeds from acoustic access to understanding through peer-enforced restraint. Speaking is used once to stop competing speech, creating the conditions for compliant hearing.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and compliance turn listening from sensation into uptake.
Attentive quiet supplies the group's receptive discipline.
Causing others to fall silent makes that discipline a coordinated social act.
An audible utterance performs the command that clears the shared field for listening.

changed_reading.after: They actively construct a quiet social space in which hearing can become understanding and compliance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The second temporal hinge links completion directly to departure as warners.
baseline_models.mechanism: Completion does not dissolve the event. It flips the cohort from receptive attendance into a consecutive outbound stage, carrying the result to its own people as warning.

activation_trace.role: Finishing and full completion provide the hinge that releases the next action.
Unbroken succession makes the outward movement follow reception without a dead interval.
Physical withdrawal from the listening site supplies the cohort's departure.
Their own collective supplies the specific destination of the transmitted result.
Danger-reporting that awakens caution defines the function produced by listening.

changed_reading.before: The audience leaves when the performance ends.
changed_reading.after: A completed reception automatically opens a second stage: immediate dispatch as a warning-bearing cohort.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Their turning away is explicitly toward their people and is predicated as warning.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same movement can be physical withdrawal from the source and relational approach to a constituency. Branches of departure, loyal care, and taking charge coexist, so leaving becomes assumption of responsibility rather than disengagement.

activation_trace.role: Turning away supplies the literal departure from the recitation site.
Taking charge activates a relational duty inside that departure.
Care and guardianship make the destination a community for which the cohort now acts.
Warning supplies the concrete form taken by their new responsibility.

changed_reading.after: They turn away from the source precisely in order to turn toward responsibility for their own collective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence repeatedly moves a book downward, through messengers, into warning and delivery, then identifies the heard book as another delivered link. The focus scene becomes a handoff: receivers reproduce the conveying function at a local social scale.

activation_trace.role: Delivery from one level to another starts the transmission chain.
Ordered written discourse supplies the transmissible object.
The messenger-and-message branch situates warning inside an established emissary sequence.
The book's danger-reporting function anticipates the cohort's final predicate.
Conveying a message to its recipients supplies the relay operation later imitated by the listeners.
The cohort's own report identifies what it heard as delivered discourse, closing the handoff.
Recitation is the audible transfer point at which the cohort receives the discourse.
Warning is the output by which receivers extend the chain.

structural_cues: The sequence 46:2, 46:9, 46:12, 46:23, and 46:30 repeatedly distinguishes source, carrier, delivered discourse, and recipient.
The focus ayah's two temporal hinges separate reception from retransmission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a recurring delivery-and-conveyance sequence; I infer that the cohort reproduces its function without claiming that it receives formal messenger status. A live alternative is spontaneous imitation by persuaded hearers rather than an appointed relay.

changed_reading.before: A persuaded audience brings a warning home.
changed_reading.after: The focus scene is a relay handoff in which recipients become secondary local carriers of delivered discourse.

context_deltas.mechanism: Appointed duration, warnings against haste, and compressed retrospective time sharpen completion into a timed hinge. The cohort neither interrupts nor lingers: it waits through the bounded event and moves when the event reaches its limit.

activation_trace.role: A fixed temporal limit supplies the wider pattern of action bounded by an appointed end.
Premature acceleration supplies the negative alternative to waiting for completion.
Remaining for a duration, later perceived as brief, frames time as bounded without being empty.
Full completion marks the legitimate release point for dispatch.
Immediate succession makes timely movement distinct from either haste or delay.

structural_cues: The repeated temporal clause in 46:29 first marks arrival and then marks completion.
The brief daytime interval in 46:35 is retained as a structural time cue because its packet inventory does not supply a matching temporal branch.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointed limits, anti-haste language, and a completed recitation; I infer a norm of waiting until the right threshold and then acting promptly. The alternative is ordinary narrative sequencing with no broader temporal ethic.

changed_reading.before: Completion merely reports when the recitation stopped.
changed_reading.after: Completion is the authorized temporal threshold between patient reception and prompt responsibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context stages a contest of directions: warned hearers turn their sides away, a messenger is accused of turning people from their objects of worship, and signs are repeatedly redirected so people might return. The focus supplies a successful circuit: the cohort is turned inward to hear, then turns outward to warn.

activation_trace.role: Presenting one's side and withdrawing supplies the failed response to prior warning.
Overturning something from its direction frames warning as disputed reorientation.
Repeatedly varying direction or presentation supplies the attempted means of return.
Return to a prior orientation states the intended endpoint of redirected signs.
The cohort's incoming redirection realizes the context's sought change of course.
Its outward turn would resemble rejection except that its destination and warning function reverse that value.

structural_cues: The destination marker in the focus ayah governs both the divine routing toward the reciter and the cohort's movement toward its people.
The ordered sequence moves from refusal of warning through disputed reorientation to hoped-for return before the focus scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed, contested, and intended changes of direction; I infer that the focus scene models successful reorientation as an inward-then-outward circuit. The alternative is a simpler contrast between disbelieving humans and receptive jinn.

changed_reading.before: God directs listeners to a recitation, after which they leave.
changed_reading.after: The ayah completes a routing circuit: redirected hearers become agents who try to redirect their own people back.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes an ignored call, possessed but useless hearing, and an explicit answer to a caller. The focus fills the conversion gap: disciplined listening turns acoustic capacity into an answer-bearing action.

activation_trace.role: Failure to remain alert leaves a call outside effective awareness.
Acoustic faculty can be present twice in the statement yet still fail to produce uptake.
Failure of sufficiency marks the gap between having a faculty and benefiting from it.
Returning an answer is the practical endpoint toward which the cohort directs its people.
A vocal call that inclines its hearer supplies the action requiring response.
Comprehending and complying provide the missing conversion from sound to response.
Attentive silence is the local operation by which that conversion is protected.

structural_cues: The cohort reports having heard in 46:30 and immediately commands an answer in 46:31.
The failure to answer is restated negatively in 46:32, making response rather than sound exposure the decisive endpoint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed awareness, useless hearing, attentive listening, and commanded response; I infer that silence is the conversion chamber between capacity and answer. A live alternative treats these as a moral contrast without a staged cognitive mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The jinn are exemplary because they hear respectfully.
changed_reading.after: Their listening is exemplary because it converts a call into comprehension, answer, and further address.

context_deltas.mechanism: Elsewhere, recited signs are rapidly mislabeled and a visible cloud is confidently misread under conditions of haste. The cohort instead stops its own speech, waits through completion, and only afterward identifies book, truth, and path. Silence becomes an anti-haste method of interpretation.

activation_trace.role: Sequential following supplies the recited signs that are prematurely categorized.
A label of deceptive turning exemplifies interpretation imposed before receptive inquiry.
Visual perception supplies information that is real but insufficiently interpreted.
Acceleration and premature demand explain the context's disastrous rush to a conclusion.
Gentle indication toward truth and a path is the considered conclusion reached after listening.
Receptive quiet suspends competing speech until the discourse can be heard as a whole.

structural_cues: The focus report withholds the cohort's interpretation until the recitation is complete; 46:30 then states its identification.
The surrounding sequence supplies several immediate verbal verdicts, while the cohort first issues only a listening command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hasty misclassification, a self-imposed pause, completion, and a later articulated reading; I infer that the pause guards interpretation. The materially live alternative is that the command is only auditory etiquette.

changed_reading.before: The command for silence is practical etiquette during recitation.
changed_reading.after: The command institutes epistemic delay, preventing premature labels until the discourse reaches completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context links reliable judgment to presence, observation, and informed testimony, while also placing jinn and humans within accountable communities. In the focus, concealed beings become present auditors whose report and warning make hidden attendance socially consequential.

activation_trace.role: Presence joined to observation establishes the context's evidentiary model.
Informed declaration shows how perceived correspondence becomes public testimony.
The concealed class is explicitly included among historically accountable communities.
Concealment creates the surprise that an unseen audience can become evidentially active.
Actual attendance anchors their later report in proximity rather than rumor.

structural_cues: The focus sequence moves from attendance to reported speech and then to warning.
The jinn-human pairing in 46:18 prevents hiddenness from functioning as exemption from communal consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies witness language, concealed beings, and actual attendance; I infer a witness-like social function for the cohort's later report. The alternative is that witness passages are independent examples and the focus only narrates conversion.

changed_reading.before: An unseen supernatural audience overhears the recitation.
changed_reading.after: Concealed auditors become socially legible through presence-based reporting and warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly places consequential address inside close relations: intergenerational obligation, a brother warning his people, and direct communal vocatives. The cohort's destination is therefore not only an ethnic label but the near social field in which received truth becomes duty.

activation_trace.role: An entrusted charge carried into another relation supplies intergenerational obligation.
Kinship makes the prior warner an insider to the people he addresses.
Repeated danger-reporting places warning within a continuing communal relation.
The warner's own collective is the immediate field of address.
Nearness without an intervening gap activates social proximity in the cohort's turn.
Care for a collective turns proximity into responsibility rather than mere belonging.

structural_cues: The resistant child and pleading parents in 46:17 show that intimate address can fail, so proximity enables but does not guarantee response.
The repeated direct communal vocatives in 46:30-31 enact the cohort's return as face-to-face address.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies family obligation, insider warning, and repeated communal address; I infer that proximity is the vehicle of the cohort's duty. The live alternative is that these are parallel examples of warning rather than a shared social mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The cohort returns to an ethnic or social destination.
changed_reading.after: It returns to the nearest sphere of obligation, where insider standing gives warning its first route.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from the speech root into a branch of smallness, which is form-distant from the surface verb. It remains anchored because that mapping is explicitly supplied and the utterance actually reduces the group's competing speech. Downstream prose should mark it as latent wordplay or acoustic modeling, not as the direct morphology of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: One brief utterance orders the many listeners into silence.

activation_trace.role: Reduction and smallness let the single speech act subtract speech from the group.
Causing others to be silent realizes that subtraction as a social action.
Understanding and compliance state what the newly cleared acoustic space enables.

changed_reading.before: A leader tells the others to be quiet.
changed_reading.after: A minimal speech act acoustically compresses the many into one receptive listening body.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it transfers the packet's womb, inward load, delivery, and separation branches into a listening scene. It remains anchored in the recitation root's own pregnancy branch and in the explicit completion-before-departure sequence. Downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for carrying and releasing a message, never as reproductive description of the cohort.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The cohort gathers the recitation inwardly, waits until completion, then separates from the source carrying warning.

activation_trace.role: An inward container gathering a developing load supplies the message-bearing analogy.
A concealed internal burden sharpens reception as carrying rather than merely storing sounds.
Release of an inward burden supplies the transition from carried discourse to public warning.
Separation after dependency models the cohort leaving the source with an independently repeatable message.
Completion prevents the release from occurring before reception has reached its limit.
Warning is the developed content released into the cohort's social world.

changed_reading.before: Listeners retain information and later repeat it.
changed_reading.after: The cohort inwardly carries an assembling message through completion, then releases it as an independent warning.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates verbal uprightness inside a noun ordinarily read simply as people. It remains valid as root resonance: the focus inventory supplies both collective and straightness branches, and 46:30 groups the communal address and straight path under the same occurrence root. Downstream prose should qualify it as paronomastic activation, not replace the ordinary collective sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The cohort turns to its people as warners rather than merely returning to a location.

activation_trace.role: The collective branch preserves the ordinary destination and social anchor.
Uprightness activates a possible result sought for that collective through warning.
Steady straightness supplies a contextual model of the stance warning may seek to produce.
The grouped root occurrence joins direct communal address to a straight path, making the resonance locally visible.
Warning supplies the intervention by which the collective might be brought to an upright stance.

changed_reading.before: They warn the people to whom they belong.
changed_reading.after: They address their collective as something to be raised into steadiness and a straight course.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it activates exchange and settlement branches inside movement and completion verbs. It remains anchored through those supplied focus branches and the nearby pattern of full recompense. Downstream prose should call it an economic analogy for converting receipt into obligation, not a claim that the encounter is a literal contract or payment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Redirection into reception is followed by completion and an immediate warning-bearing return.

activation_trace.role: Exchange and differential value allow reception to be modeled as conversion rather than passive possession.
Settling what is due lets completed hearing incur a corresponding outward act.
Fullness without shortfall supplies the contextual pattern of complete return.
An answering consequence matched to an act supplies the pay-forward analogy.
Warning is the social return made on what the cohort has received.

changed_reading.before: The cohort freely receives a message and chooses to share it.
changed_reading.after: Receiving the completed discourse creates value that is paid forward through warning rather than retained.

strongest_changes: The scene changed from a chance hearing into an inward-then-outward routing circuit.
Listening changed from acoustic exposure into the disciplined conversion of a call into answer and further address.
The silence command changed from etiquette into an anti-haste method that delays interpretation until completion.
The return to the cohort's people changed from simple travel into a local relay enacted through social proximity and responsibility.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah compresses routing, gathering, silence, completion, departure, and warning into one reversible movement. Split mappings and cross-context root recurrences keep several additional readings alive: speech that removes speech, a message carried to maturity, a collective invited into uprightness, and receipt converted into a social return.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not decide whether the cohort is formally commissioned or spontaneously imitates the conveying function it has heard.
The care and governance branches of the turning and collective roots may be genuine relational activation or only secondary resonance around the explicit destination.
The gestational, uprightness, and exchange models are traceable but should remain exploratory analogies rather than lexical replacements.
